description: Odzwierny, the tall grim gatekeeper of the underworld, a gaunt grey-skinned man in a long black coat and a fur hat, a big ring of white bone keys hanging from his belt, swinging a huge bone key like a mace, cold pale eyes, menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the figure alone, no gate, no ground, no background, the whole figure inside the picture
